title: The Open Mic
description: A nervous teen with severe stage fright tries to share an original poem at a crowded local coffeehouse.
character_reference: a tall young man with messy dark curls, wearing an oversized cable-knit sweater and round wire-rimmed glasses

scenes.narration: My palms were completely soaked as I clutched the crumpled notebook against my chest. Every single seat in the room was taken, and the low murmur of conversation felt like a wall of sound.
scenes.visual: close-up of trembling hands clutching a dog-eared notebook, warm amber overhead pendant lighting, blurred background of crowded wooden tables inside a dimly lit indie coffee shop

scenes.narration: When the host called my name, my stomach dropped straight to my toes. I stood up so fast my chair scraped loudly against the wooden floorboards, drawing unwanted attention.
scenes.visual: medium shot looking up from floor level as a youth stands abruptly beside an empty wooden chair, eyes wide with sudden panic, ambient shadows cast against exposed brick

scenes.narration: Walking toward the small wooden stage felt like marching across a mile-long tightrope. The microphone stand loomed ahead like a metal skeleton waiting for me to trip.
scenes.visual: low angle perspective focusing on a solitary metal microphone stand under a single overhead spotlight, dark wooden floorboards stretching toward empty velvet chairs

scenes.narration: I stepped up to the mic, opened my mouth, and absolute silence came out. My throat was too tight to push even a single syllable past my lips.
scenes.visual: tight cinematic close-up of a terrified face staring straight ahead into a silver microphone grille, sweat glistening on the temple, dark blurred background

scenes.narration: I looked down at the messy ink on the page, willing myself to remember why I wrote this. Instead of reading the whole poem, I decided to just speak the very first line.
scenes.visual: extreme close-up of hand holding a blue pen over lined paper filled with frantic handwriting, soft warm rim lighting cutting across the page

scenes.narration: My voice shook on the first word, but then it steadied into a normal rhythm. Faces in the front row leaned in closer, listening instead of judging.
scenes.visual: profile shot showing mouth parted mid-speech near a metallic microphone, soft atmospheric lighting, gentle focus on determined expression

scenes.narration: When I finished the final line, a scattering of genuine applause echoed through the room. A massive weight lifted straight off my shoulders.
scenes.visual: close-up of a relieved smile breaking across the face, eyes closed in quiet triumph, warm ambient glow reflecting off wire frames

scenes.narration: Stepping off that tiny stage, I knew I could face the microphone again tomorrow. Follow along for more everyday stories of growing up.
scenes.visual: person walking away down a dimly lit hallway toward a glowing exit sign, holding a notebook tightly, cinematic moody color grading
